d.t: Sub-surface drainage modules for drainage of landscape feature.
d.s: SikaRoof VersiCell is a lightweight, high-strength drainage module manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP) with cells 30 mm high, providing large internal void volumes for increased drainage discharge capacity. SikaRoof VersiCell forms a hollow space between the structural element and the planting media, providing excellent drainage to prevent flooding of the landscape features.
a: Interlocking modular design ensuring continuous drainage
Small surface perforations to prevent sagging of geotextile
Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Operates within a wide service temperature range
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
us: Drainage layer for intensive green roofs, podium landscapes, planter boxes and retaining wall backfill drainage systems in combination with a suitable geotextile as a filtration layer to prevent planting media from clogging the drainage layer.
d.pk: Each piece is 500 x 500 and pre-clipped in 1/m2 panels. Packed with 60/m2 per pallet

sec.t: No expiration date if the product is stored in accordance to the storage conditions as stated in this Product Data Sheet

Product must be stored in their original packing, laid in a horizontal position, and under cool and dry conditions. The product must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, and any other elements
